access_notes.comment: Several authoritative publishers answer automated requests with a bot challenge (202) or a refusal (403/429) while serving the document normally to a browser. Recorded per source under access.automated so the link checker separates 'blocked to robots' from 'dead'.

Investment Services Rules for Notified Alternative Investment Funds — Part A: The Notified AIF Framework
sources.note: Rules verified against the 30 May 2025 version (v4.00) on 2026-08-25. Rule 1.02: NAIFs are exempt from licensing under the Investment Services Act subject to inclusion in the List of Notified AIFs. Rule 2.01: promoted to Professional and/or Qualifying Investors only; managed by a full-scope AIFM authorised under AIFMD; the AIFM assumes responsibility for the NAIF. Rule 2.02: notification unavailable to self-managed schemes, schemes not marketed exclusively to Professional/Qualifying Investors, and loan-origination schemes unless established under the EuVECA or EuSEF Regulations. Rule 3.01: Qualifying Investors invest a minimum of EUR 100,000, not reducible below that amount by partial redemption, plus a written declaration of awareness of the risks. Rule 4.04: notification filed within 30 calendar days of the governing body resolution and before the prospectus effective date. Rule 4.05: MFSA includes the AIF in the List within 10 working days of a duly completed filing.

Decreto del Ministero dell'economia e delle finanze 13 gennaio 2022, n. 19 — modifiche all'articolo 14 del D.M. 30/2015
sources.note: Amends article 14 of D.M. 30/2015. The EUR 500,000 minimum continues to apply to a direct, non-advised subscription by a non-professional investor; a EUR 100,000 minimum applies where the subscription is made through an investment advisory service, subject to a limit of 10 per cent of the investor's financial portfolio.

sources.title: Wiecki, Campbell, Lent & Stauth, 'All That Glitters Is Not Gold: Comparing Backtest and Out-of-Sample Performance on a Large Cohort of Trading Algorithms', The Journal of Investing 25(3), 2016
sources.note: Figures used: 888 algorithmic strategies developed and backtested on the Quantopian platform, each with at least six months of out-of-sample performance; the backtest Sharpe ratio explained less than 2.5 per cent of the variation in out-of-sample Sharpe (R-squared below 0.025).
